name: subtie-reading
description: Discuss your books and create personalized language practice using your Subtie account.

interface.longDescription: Discuss books without spoilers, find your next read, and create vocabulary cards and optional exercises in your connected Subtie account.
defaultPrompt: Suggest a book to read next
Create vocabulary cards about a topic

positive.prompt: What language and proficiency level do I have set in Subtie?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the connected account settings and report configured languages and level without changing them.

positive.prompt: Discuss the book I have been reading most recently, without spoilers.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the most recently updated accessible book and ask one natural question. Do not claim to have its complete text.

positive.prompt: Show up to five of my active vocabulary cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most five cards belonging to the connected account; do not change their review status.

positive.prompt: Create and save three English-to-Ukrainian cards about ordering coffee. Show me the cards before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Show three proposed cards, allow review, and save the approved set in one request. Confirm only after successful persistence.

positive.prompt: Create a saved Subtie exercise for English travel vocabulary.
positive.expected_behavior: Save a small set of cards with a unique exercise tag and a configuration that uses that tag; preserve account repetition defaults and clearly report partial failures.

negative.prompt: Write a recipe for chocolate cake.
Show another user's Subtie books and vocabulary.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt another identity or accept a supplied user ID; explain that access is limited to the connected account.

negative.prompt: Explain how CEFR language levels work.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the levels without updating the saved language level, creating vocabulary, or changing exercises.

prompts: What language and proficiency level do I have set in Subtie?
Discuss the book I have been reading most recently, without spoilers.
Show up to five of my active vocabulary cards.
Create and save three English-to-Ukrainian cards about ordering coffee. Show me the cards before saving.
Help me assess my language level without changing my saved settings.

publication.release_notes: Migrates the Subtie tutor workflows from the custom GPT to a plugin with account settings, reading history, vocabulary cards, optional saved exercises, and language-level assessment. Reports missing account connections explicitly instead of substituting a generic conversation.
